news.headline: uniQure sets Q3 2026 results for November 4
news.summary: uniQure announced it will report third-quarter 2026 financial results and give a company update on November 4, 2026, earlier than the November 9-10 window third-party calendars had projected. The timing falls just after the FDA's 60-day filing review on the AMT-130 BLA ends around November 1, so the call is likely to carry the acceptance and priority-review outcome.

news.headline: JPMorgan Chase lifts its passive uniQure stake to about 8.5% (5.95M shares)
news.summary: An amended Schedule 13G/A shows JPMorgan Chase holding 5,951,794 uniQure shares (about 8.5%) through several subsidiaries, up from 4.87M shares (7.0%) reported in July. The increase through the post-readout selloff signals that at least one large holder added rather than exited after the four-year AMT-130 data.

news.headline: UBS assumes coverage at Buy and lifts its price target to $48 from $27
news.summary: UBS took over coverage with a Buy rating and a $48 target, arguing the filing rests on the stronger 36-month data that the FDA had agreed to as the basis for accelerated approval. Together with other bullish notes it helped the stock rebound from the post-readout lows, with shares up about 7% to $22.52 on October 15.

news.headline: Barclays downgrades uniQure to Equal-Weight and cuts its target to $28 from $60
news.summary: Barclays analyst Eliana Merle downgraded the stock, citing greater uncertainty around AMT-130 after the four-year data, sending shares down about 5.5%. Goldman Sachs (Neutral, $46 to $31) and RBC ($65 to $48) also cut their targets after the readout.

news.headline: Four-year AMT-130 data: 44% cUHDRS slowing at high dose, not statistically significant
news.summary: In 12 high-dose patients at 48 months, AMT-130 slowed cUHDRS decline by 44% versus the Enroll-HD external control (p=0.144), while Total Functional Capacity held up at 61% slowing (p=0.008). uniQure stressed that the BLA rests on the 36-month analysis, which it restated as 80% cUHDRS slowing (p=0.005) and 67% TFC slowing; critics pointed to missing data and possible survivor bias in the control group. Shares fell about 39% that day, from a $39.11 close to well below the $45.50 price of the June equity raise.

news.headline: uniQure submits US BLA and UK MAA for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease
news.summary: uniQure filed a Biologics License Application with the FDA seeking accelerated approval for ifezuntirgene inilparvovec (AMT-130) and, in parallel, a Marketing Authorisation Application with the UK MHRA, both supported by the three-year Phase I/II analysis versus a propensity-score-matched Enroll-HD external control. The company requested priority review, which would compress the FDA review to six months after the 60-day filing review.

catalysts.label: FDA filing decision and priority review determination
catalysts.detail: The FDA's 60-day filing review on the BLA submitted September 2 ends around November 1, 2026; as of October 30 no acceptance notice has been issued, so it should be communicated in the coming days or with the November 4 Q3 results. The decision will show whether priority review was granted (six-month vs ten-month clock, i.e. roughly Q2 vs Q4 2027 action) and normally sets the PDUFA date. After the weaker four-year data, a clean acceptance on the 36-month package is the key test of whether the FDA still stands behind the agreed filing basis.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 results and regulatory update
catalysts.detail: uniQure confirmed on October 28 that it will report Q3 2026 results and provide a company update on November 4, 2026 (its 2026 calls have been held at 8:30 a.m. ET). Expect updates on BLA acceptance, review designation and PDUFA date, the UK MAA, the FDA's view of the four-year data, confirmatory-trial start-up, AMT-260 second-cohort enrollment and cash burn against the $810.3M June 30 cash position.

catalysts.label: FDA advisory committee (AdCom) decision
catalysts.detail: Management said in July it considers an advisory committee for the first Huntington's gene therapy probable and is preparing for one. The four-year data, with missing-data and control-group questions, make a public AdCom more likely; any announcement would most likely come with or after the filing decision in early November.

catalysts.label: Confirmatory trial initiation
catalysts.detail: uniQure and the FDA have aligned on a roughly 200-patient confirmatory study randomized 2:1 to AMT-130 versus standard of care, with Total Functional Capacity at 36 months as the primary endpoint. The company expects enrollment underway before the accelerated-approval decision; notably, TFC was the endpoint that stayed statistically significant at four years.

catalysts.label: Additional international regulatory pathways
catalysts.detail: uniQure has said it is pursuing registration routes for AMT-130 beyond the US and UK, including EU options, with an update guided for the second half of 2026. No EMA or other-jurisdiction filing plan has been disclosed yet.

catalysts.label: AMT-260 higher-dose epilepsy data and AMT-191 Fabry update
catalysts.detail: Updated Phase I/IIa data in refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy, including the second, higher-dose cohort, are planned for H1 2027 after first-cohort data in June 2026 showed 79-100% disabling-seizure reductions in three of six patients. A Fabry (AMT-191) update is guided to the same window, but dosing there is paused pending evaluation of liver enzyme elevations in two mid-dose patients. With AMT-130 sentiment damaged, these pipeline readouts carry more weight.

catalysts.label: ICER evidence report and CEPAC verdict
catalysts.detail: ICER's draft evidence report on AMT-130 is due in January 2027, followed by a Midwest CEPAC public meeting and vote in March 2027 and a final report in April 2027 - close to a potential FDA action date. The four-year durability data will feed directly into its cost-effectiveness modeling for a one-time gene therapy.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA accelerated approval decision for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: If priority review is granted, the FDA action date would land around late April or early May 2027, potentially making AMT-130 the first approved disease-modifying therapy for Huntington's disease. Without priority review the decision slips toward late 2027.

catalysts.label: UK MHRA marketing authorisation decision
catalysts.detail: The MAA filed with the MHRA on September 2 runs on its own clock, independent of the FDA, offering a second potential approval route. uniQure has not disclosed an expected MHRA decision timeline.

pulse: QURE remains range-bound in the low $20s a month after the September 29 four-year AMT-130 data (non-significant 44% cUHDRS slowing, ~39% one-day drop), with analysts split between UBS at Buy ($48) and Barclays at Equal-Weight ($28) and JPMorgan lifting its stake to about 8.5%. As of October 30 there is still no FDA filing-acceptance notice for the 36-month-based BLA, whose 60-day review ends around November 1, and the company has set Q3 results for November 4. The acceptance and priority-review decision, the PDUFA date and any advisory-committee signal are the next binary moment for the stock.
